sources.name: BASF Ultramid A3K uncoloured PA66 product information September 2026
sources.facts: At 23 C tensile modulus dry/conditioned 3000/1100 MPa; yield stress 85/50 MPa; conditioned creep modulus at 1000 h and strain <=0.5% 700 MPa.
sources.limit: Typical grade values. No complete constitutive curve, fatigue law, manufactured-part qualification or equivalence to the assumed E3500 model.

sources.name: Rogers PORON 4701-40 product page
sources.facts: 4701-40-15 listed density 240 kg/m3 and typical 25% compression force deflection 41 kPa.
sources.limit: Product-page value only. Not mixed with ISO global sheet values. Not a full foam law or headphone comfort result.

sources.name: Rogers global standards datasheet
sources.facts: ISO 6916-1 compression measured at 25% deflection and 30 mm/min; typical values are not specification limits.
sources.limit: Different test conditions from product-page table; no substituted or combined curve.

sources.name: Sony India WH-CH720N support article 00198705
sources.facts: Replacement methods depend on model; article refers users to authorised service.
sources.limit: This reviewed article supplies no skirt/groove/carrier tolerances. Not a claim that dimensions cannot exist elsewhere.

calculations.name: Same linear beam geometry and imposed deflection modulus ratio
calculations.meaning: Conditional linear force and stiffness ratio only. No assertion that a finished band behaves linearly or matches this grade.

calculations.name: Uniform reference foam compression force
calculations.meaning: Illustrative 1000 mm2 coupon at the product-page 25% compression point. Not real pad contact area, head force, comfort or seal.

scope: Candidate source and dimensional-analysis screen only; no final material selection, purchase recommendation or new physical validation.
